summary: Review authentication and session code for identity binding, lifecycle, privilege transitions and cross-channel consistency.

must_inspect.why: Creation, refresh, revocation and expiry must preserve the intended security boundary.
false_positive_guards: Short expiry does not compensate for missing authorization checks.

must_inspect.why: Role or account changes should not leave stale credentials with broader authority than intended.
false_positive_guards: Do not require immediate global revocation unless the threat model needs it.

must_inspect.why: HTTP, websocket, background and internal paths should not apply inconsistent identity rules.
false_positive_guards: Different mechanisms can still implement the same invariant.
Do not expose secrets in report evidence.
